# oath — OATH one-time passwords

[All groups](README.md)

## oath code

Compute an OATH one-time password (HOTP RFC 4226 or TOTP RFC 6238; SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512; 6 to 8 digits) from a secret or an otpauth:// URI, and optionally verify a code within a window, reporting clock drift. Checks secret length and settings authenticator apps may ignore.

MCP tool: `oath_code`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--uri` | string | otpauth://totp/... or otpauth://hotp/... URI (it contains the secret). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_URI`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--secret` | string | Shared secret (base32 by default). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SECRET`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--secret-format` | string | Encoding of secret. Default `base32`. One of `base32`, `hex`, `ascii`. |
| `--type` | string | Algorithm when not from a URI. Default `totp`. One of `totp`, `hotp`. |
| `--algorithm` | string | HMAC hash. Default `SHA1`. One of `SHA1`, `SHA256`, `SHA512`. |
| `--digits` | int | Code length. Default `6`. |
| `--period` | int | TOTP time step in seconds. Default `30`. |
| `--counter` | int | HOTP counter. Default `0`. |
| `--at-time` | string | TOTP at this time (Unix seconds or RFC 3339) instead of now. |
| `--code` | string | A code to verify. |
| `--window` | int | Steps either side (TOTP) or ahead (HOTP) to accept. Default `1`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
